proof_conditions: The normalized graph contains exactly one Inner and one Left GraceJoinCore and both are reached through recognized stage programs; unsupported physical joins are rejected.

Every outer reconstruction key pair is mapped by exact wide key positions to two field tokens with the same terminal shared stage and source field, different consistent output ports, and identical direct or one-step StablePickle codec.
The outer-left identity covers every exposed shared source field exactly once and traverses no post-hub deduplication or Inner join.
Every outer-right identity field specifically passes through the Inner join LEFT output mapping, not merely through the same join somewhere.
The inner-left stream contains the complete original field set from its shared port, and a common key-only domain groups on exactly that full set with no extra, unknown or encoded keys.
A recognized domain has direct unique key selection, zero state outputs in init/update, correct argument arities, and a bijective finish over only those keys. Non-key reductions erase provenance.
Unknown scalar computation erases its output provenance. Unknown transport erases stream provenance. No generic ancestry or callable-presence fallback can produce a field token.
Terminal shared branches must be bijective direct Member maps over the same nonempty source field set; stage connections and output-port indices are resolved by node identity.
